content.short: Pocket Portal is a decentralized infrastructure providing faster and more reliable access to data.
content.description: Pocket Portal provides a single, fully hosted solution for accessing on-chain data, helping developers move toward a fairer, more resilient, and higher-performing internet. By removing network-connection hurdles, it lets engineers focus on solving core problems and delivering a better user experience. As a decentralized RPC provider, Pocket Portal enables builders to mint endpoints across 30+ networks, delivering cheaper and lower-latency access to blockchain data.
